title: Handoff spec v1
description: The JSON document an agent produces to hand a unit of work to the person at the machine. Structure only: emptiness after trimming, placeholders, control fields and unknown value keys are semantic rules applied after this schema.

spec_version.description: Format version. The version check runs before this schema, so a higher version is answered with an update instruction rather than a list of unknown fields.

where.description: Where to act: a service, an application or an OS settings panel, with page or section.

url.description: Starting point openable with one click.

why_human.description: Why a person performs this work.

values.description: Values to use, taken from the project. Keys are user-defined. May be empty.

secrets.description: Variable name to destination file, for values the user copies from the external service into a project file. Values never appear here.

steps.description: Ordered steps, shown one at a time.

verify.description: The check the agent performs itself after the user is done. Must never read a value listed in secrets.

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag of the texts, a hint for OCR and runbooks.

url.description: Closed list of schemes: http, https, ms-settings:, x-apple.systempreferences:.

value_name.description: A key of the top-level values map.

value.description: A single value or a list of values. Empty strings pass the schema and are rejected by the semantic rules, which is what makes a draft spec derived from a runbook invalid until the agent fills it.

step.description: A step is always an object; strings with placeholders are not accepted.

values.description: Keys into the top-level values map. Omitted, never empty, when the step uses no value.
